== frame trailing_comment cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a # b c
|a
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame hash_inside_word cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a # b c
|a
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a#b
|a#b
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame comment_only cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a # b c
|a
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a#b
|a#b
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ # only a comment
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 #
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame hash_in_quotes cursor=11,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a # b c
|a
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a#b
|a#b
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ # only a comment
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo 'a # b' "c # d"
|a # b c # d
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 #
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@11 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
